title: AI News Daily — July 26, 2026
summary: OpenAI and Anthropic are privately lobbying Washington to restrict the open-weight AI models they publicly claim to support, a split that lands amid a frenzy of AI chip dealmaking: Anthropic is now courting its own chip supply from SK Hynix, Samsung just landed a $200 billion foundry deal with Broadcom, and Chinese memory maker CXMT's IPO drew record demand — while DeepSeek paused its own fundraising after its founder's blunt admission that China still trails the US in AI went viral.
